items.title: Energy Informatics
items.description:
The two-volume set LNCS 16981 + 16982 constitutes the proceedings of the 6th Energy Informatics Academy Conference, EI.A 2026, which took place in Beijing, China, during October 14, 2026. 

The 41 full papers and 13 Short papers included in the proceedings were carefully reviewed and selected from 77 submissions. They focus on a unique perspective on how digitalization is transforming the technical, economic, and societal dimensions of modern energy systems. They were organized in topical sections as follows: 

Part I: Flexibility, Forecasting and Supply in District Heating; Digital Transformation of Buildings into Active Energy Prosumers; HVAC, Thermal Comfort and Building Energy Performance; Trustworthy Data and Language Models for Energy Systems; 

Part II: Probabilistic Forecasting and Decision-Making under Uncertainty; Data- and AI-Driven Energy–Climate–Economy Modeling for Mitigation–Adaptation Transitions; Industrial Systems Under Climate and Energy Uncertainty: Adaptation Readiness, Energy Resilience, and Digital Intelligence; Grid Resilience, Energy Storage and Electric Mobility; From Living Labs to Virtual Testbeds: Experimentation and Validation in Energy Informatics.

items.title: Hybrid Intelligence in Business
items.description:
This book constitutes the proceedings of the 25th International Conference on Perspectives in Business Informatics Research, BIR 2026, which took place in Olten, Switzerland, in October 2026. The central theme of BIR 2026 was “Hybrid Intelligence in Business”. 

The 28 full papers and 6 short papers included in the proceedings were carefully reviewed and selected from 56 submissions. They were organized in topical sections as follows: Design of Hybrid Intelligence Systems and Processes; Ethical, Responsible, and Accountable AI and Digital Trust; AI-supported Data and Knowledge Management; Alignment, Interoperability, and Openness; Smart Systems and Application Areas; Short Papers.

items.title: Intelligent Simulation
items.description:
This 2-volume set CCIS 3155 - 3156 constitutes the proceedings of the 38th China Simulation Conference, CSC 2026, held in Changzhou, China, during October 16–18, 2026. 
The total of 67 papers included in the proceedings was carefully reviewed and selected from 334 submissions. They were organized in topical sections as follows: 
Part 1 : Basic theories and methods of simulation science and engineering; Modeling and simulation of complex systems/systems-of-systems, control theory and applications; Modeling and simulation of integrated natural environments and virtual reality environments; Multi-agent simulation and large model agent simulation (LLM-Agent); Physics-informed machine learning, world models, and generative simulation; Parallel and distributed simulation, high-performance simulation, cloud simulation, and edge simulation; Simulation model verification and validation (V&V) technologies. 
Part 2 : Simulation standards, simulation tools, simulation support environments, simulation systems, and simulators; CAE, virtual prototyping, and model-based systems engineering (MBSE); Discrete event system simulation, logistics simulation, production line simulation, and supply chain simulation; Control theory and applications, intelligent simulation optimization and scheduling, industrial internet and simulation, green manufacturing and simulation, intelligent manufacturing and simulation; Control theory and applications, intelligent simulation optimization and scheduling, industrial internet and simulation, green manufacturing and simulation, intelligent manufacturing and simulation; Other new theories, methods, and technologies related to simulation.

items.title: Pattern Recognition. ICPR 2026 International Workshops
items.description: This 5-volume set LNCS 17110-7114 constitutes the proceedings of the ICPR 2026 International Workshops held under the umbrella of the 28th International Conference on Pattern Recognition, ICPR 2026, which took place in Lyon, France, during August 17–22, 2026. The 239 full papers presented in these 5 volumes were carefully reviewed and selected from 322 submissions. The ICPR 2026 workshops addresses challenges in pattern recognition, artificial intelligence, computer vision, image and sound analysis, and related fields. The papers reflect the latest advances and applications in healthcare, biometrics, ethics, multimodal learning, cultural heritage, imagery, affective computing, de-escalation, and many other emerging areas.

items.title: Mindful TEL: Learning Technologies Shaped with Intention
items.description:
The EC-TEL 2026 proceedings reflect a dynamic and interdisciplinary field, bridging pedagogy, educational psychology, and digital technology. 
 The 104 papers (45 Research track, 3 Practitioner and Industry track, and 43 posters, 13 demos) presented in these two volumes were carefully reviewed and selected from 295 submissions, of which 194 were from the Research track, 13 from the Practitioner and Industry track, 64 posters, and 24 demos. 
 The proceedings are organized in two parts, including the following topical sections: Part I: Research Track; Industry and Practitioner; and Part II: Poster; Demo.

items.title: Software Architecture
items.description:
This volume consists of the refereed proceedings of the 20th European Conference on Software Architecture, ECSA 2026, held in Bolzano, Italy, during September 7 - 11, 2026. 

The 34 full papers and 7 short papers included in these volumes were carefully reviewed and selected from 109 submissions, and are categorized under Research and Industrial for each.

items.title: Runtime Verification
items.description:
This book constitutes the refereed proceedings of the 26th International Conference on Runtime Verification, RV 2026, held in Kingston, ON, Canada, during October 6–9, 2026. 

The 9 regular papers, 5 short papers, 4 tool papers, 1 tutorial paper, 1 benchmark paper and 3 tool showcase papers included in this book were carefully reviewed and selected from 65 submissions. They focus on topics in Runtime Verification including online and offline monitoring of formal specifications, shielding intelligent systems, quantitative verdict domains, as well as related research into AI safety and out-of-distribution detection. Runtime verification techniques have gained increasing acceptance as means to achieve system correctness, reliability, and robustness; they provide an additional level of rigor and effectiveness compared to conventional testing and are generally more practical than exhaustive formal verification.

items.title: Reorienting the Digital: Ethics, Ontology, and Sustainable Futures
items.description:
This book constitutes the refereed proceedings of the 19th IFIP WG 9.4 International Conference on Implications of Information and Digital Technologies for Development, ICT4D 2026, which was held in Kathmandu, Nepal, during May 25-27, 2026. 

The 75 full papers included in these volumes were carefully reviewed and selected from 135 submissions.

items.title: Computer Security – ESORICS 2026
Static Analysis
items.description:
This book constitutes the refereed proceedings of the 33rd International Static Analysis Symposium, SAS 2026, held in Oakland, CA, USA, during October 6–8, 2026. 
The 20 papers included here were carefully reviewed and selected from 43 submissions. They focus on abstract interpretation, automated deduction, data flow analysis, debugging techniques, deductive methods, emerging applications, model checking, data science, program optimizations and transformations, program synthesis, program verification, machine learning and verification, security analysis, tool environments and architectures, theoretical frameworks, type checking, distributed or networked systems, and LLM for static analysis and static analysis for LLM.

items.title: Intelligent Transport Systems
items.description:
This book constitutes the refereed proceedings of the 9th International Conference on Intelligent Transport Systems, INTSYS 2025, held in Marietta, GA, USA, on December 10, 2025 . 
The 10 full papers presented in this book were carefully reviewed and selected from 24 submissions. 
The papers are organized in the following topical sections: Electric Vehicles - Charging, Batteries, and Structural Safety; Vehicular Networking, V2X Communications, and Cooperative Control; Security, Forensics, and Trust in Connected Mobility Systems; AI, Multimodal Learning, and Intelligent Mobility Applications and Posters & and Demos

items.title: Advancements in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
items.description: This volume presents the proceedings of the International Conference on Emerging Research in Computing, Information, Communication, Artificial Intelligence, and Machine Learning (ERCICAM 2025) . The book covers a wide range of emerging topics, including the Internet of Things (IoT), wireless communications, image and video processing, parallel and distributed computing, and smart grid applications, among others. Exploring these domains provides valuable insights and practical knowledge for academics, industry professionals, and practitioners seeking to stay at the forefront of technological advancements.

items.title: Recent Advances in the Message Passing Interface
items.description:
This book constitutes the proceedings of the 33rd European MPI Users' Group Meeting, EuroMPI 2026, held in Vienna, Austria, during October 7–9, 2026. 
The 12 full papers included in this book were carefully reviewed and selected from 17 submissions. They cover a broad spectrum of topics, including extensions to the MPI standard, communication algorithms, runtime systems, programming models and libraries built on MPI, interfaces to other parallel programming systems, performance optimization for emerging architectures and networks, correctness and verification techniques, and tools supporting the development of scalable parallel applications.

items.title: Machine Learning and Knowledge Discovery in Databases. Applied Data Science Track
items.description:
This multi-volume set, LNAI 16941-16950, constitutes the refereed proceedings of the European Conference on Machine Learning and Knowledge Discovery in Databases, ECML PKDD 2026, held in Naples, Italy, during September 7–11, 2026. 

The papers inlcuded in these proceedings were carefully reviewed and selected; they were organised in different conference tracks: 280 full papers were accepted for the Research Track out of 1150 submissions, and 90 full papers for the Applied Data Science Track out of 381 submissions. The remaining short papers included in these proceedings are from the Demo Track (27 papers out of 38 submissions) and the Industrial Track (21 papers out of 42 submissions). The papers cover the following topical sections: 
 
 The Research Track (LNAI 16941-16948): Anomaly & Outlier Detection; Anomaly Detection, Active Learning & Data-Centric Learning; AutoML, Data-Centric & Statistical Learning; Bias & Fairness; Biomedical AI; Causal Discovery & Causal Inference; Clustering & Pattern Mining; Continual Learning; Evaluation & Trustworthy AI; Federated Learning; Federated Learning & Machine Unlearning; Generative & Difusion Models; Graph Learning & Applications; Graph Learning & Graph Inference; Graph Neural Networks; Graph, Language & Decision Learning; Images & Computer Vision; Interpretability & Explainability; Knowledge Graphs & Graph Representation Learning; Large Language Models; Learning Theory & Probabilistic ML; Model Reliability & Evaluation; Multimodal, Vision & 3D Reconstruction; Neuro-Symbolic Learning; Optimization, Bandits & Online Learning; Recommender Systems & Ranking; Reinforcement Learning & Decision Making; Representation Learning; Representation, Alignment & Generative Learning; Robustness, Counterfactuals & Explanations; Robustness, Uncertainty & Trustworthy ML; Security, Privacy & Trustworthy AI; Structured Graphs, Causal & Relational Learning; Supervised & Weakly-Supervised Learning; Text Mining & Information Retrieval; Text Mining,

items.title: Software Engineering of Emerging Technologies
items.description:
This volume 3125 - 3126 constitutes the refereed proceedings of the Second International Conference on Software Engineering for Emerging Technologies, SEET 2026, held at Behrend, PA, USA during August 10–11, 2026. 

The 60 papers included in this book were carefully reviewed and selected from 147 submissions. They were organized into the following topical sections: 

Part 1: Regular Research; Idea and Vision; Short Research Paper; Student Research Competition. 

Part 2 : Student Research Competition; Ph.D Research.

items.title: Advanced Technologies in Electronics, Communications and Signal Processing
items.description:
This book constitutes the proceedings of the Second EAI International Conference on Advanced Technologies in Electronics, Communications and Signal Processing, ICATECS 2026, held in Hyderabad, India, during January 30-31, 2026. 

The 30 full papers included in this book were carefully reviewed and selected from 116 submissions. They are organized into the following topical sections: Wireless Communications & Signal Processing; Electronic Systems; Embedded and Machine Learning Approaches; Biomedical and Computing Systems; Communication Networks; and Electronics in Healthcare.

items.title: Mindful TEL: Learning Technologies Shaped with Intention

The EC-TEL 2026 proceedings reflect a dynamic and interdisciplinary field, bridging pedagogy, educational psychology, and digital technology. 

The 104 papers (45 Research track, 3 Practitioner and Industry track, and 43 posters, 13 demos) presented in these two volumes were carefully reviewed and selected from 295 submissions, of which 194 were from the Research track, 13 from the Practitioner and Industry track, 64 posters, and 24 demos. 

The proceedings are organized in two parts, including the following topical sections: Part I: Research Track; Industry and Practitioner; and Part II: Poster; Demo.

items.title: Constructive Approaches for Security Analysis and Design of Embedded Systems
items.description:
This book constitutes the refereed proceedings of the Second International Conference on Constructive Approaches for Security Analysis and Design of Embedded Systems, CASCADE 2026, held in Regensburg, Germany, during March 30–April 1, 2026. 

 The 21 full papers included in this book were carefully reviewed and selected from 43 submissions. They are organized into topical sections as follows: Processor architecture and micro-architecture; Masking; Physical Unclonable Functions; Side-channel Analysis; and Fault Injection.

items.title: Design, Learning, and Innovation
items.description:
This book constitutes the refereed proceedings of the 10th International Conference on Design, Learning, and Innovation, DLI 2026, held in Copenhagen, Denmark, during May 20–21, 2026. 
The 33 full papers included in this volume were carefully reviewed and selected from 80 submissions. They are organized into the following topical sections: Designing Interactive Technologies for Learning and Human Development; Creative and Transformative Practices in Learning and Teaching; Digital Pedagogies and Transformative Teaching Practices; Design and Evaluation of Digital Systems for Creative and Learning Practices; Designing for AI in Higher Education: Cross-Nordic Perspectives on Teacher Agency, Capability, and Institutional Tensions; Designing Learning Systems and Practices Across Contexts; and Design Ideation, Meaning-Making, and Creative Practice in Digital Contexts.

items.title: Information and Knowledge Systems. Artificial Intelligence, Learning Analytics and Data Trust
items.description:
This book constitutes the refereed proceedings of the 7th International Conference on Information and Knowledge Systems, ICIKS 2025, held in Sousse, Tunisia, during October 2025. 
 The 19 full papers and 1 short paper included in this book were carefully reviewed and selected from 55 submissions. They were organized in topical sections as follows: A rtificial Intelligence and Data-Driven Modelling; Intelligent Information Systems and Digital Environments; and Knowledge Representation and Language Technologies.
